title: Relay mailbox send and read to a remote runner intermittently fail with a 503 / non-JSON reply although the operation succeeded
outcome: A relay mailbox send or read to or from a remote host returns a definite, parseable outcome. When the outcome is genuinely unknown, the response is structured (JSON with a typed code), not bare tool text that breaks clients' parsers.
acceptance: The cause of the paired failures at about 22:49Z on 2026-10-31 is identified with evidence: the coordinator's send got a 503 'native mailbox append replied but its local outcome remains unconfirmed', and the remote runner's read of the same message got a non-JSON 'TermAl del…' text response.
Unknown-outcome responses from termal_send_to_session and termal_read_mailbox are always structured, with a typed reason code, so a client can parse them and retry idempotently.
A test covers the relay append path where the remote host replies but local confirmation is pending, and asserts the structured response and idempotent recovery.
